Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Those who approach anyone other than You are disappointed
And those who seek from anyone except You are losers
And those who turn to anyone other than You are lost

Arabic text: وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُونَ إِلَّا مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ
Translation: And those who seek provisions will find drought except for those who seek Your bounty
Your door is open for those who desire
And Your goodness is available for those who seek
And Your grace is accessible to those who ask
And Your gifts are attainable for those who hope
And Your provision is extended even to those who disobey You
And Your forbearance reaches even those who oppose You
Your way is to be good to those who do evil
And Your path is to be patient with transgressors
O Allah! Guide me with the guidance of those who are guided
And grant me the striving of those who strive
And do not make me among the heedless and the distant ones
And forgive me on the Day of Judgment
